regions.merged_text: Pl. pardon delay in acknowledgement. Hope by this time things have adjusted themselves brigher and better than before.
regions.full_page: Pl. pardon delay in acknowledgement. Hope by this time things have adjusted themselves brigher and better than before.

regions.merged_text: P. S. God bless you Mrs. O"Donnell again. Having written the acknowledgement over several weeks ago without mailing it at once, I just found it snowed under other work. I hope things have adjusted themselves brighter before this. Brs. Francis and Leo and all send Best Regards. Now that the season for it is fast approaching we wish you all the blessings that go to make a really blessed Christmas and Happy New Year.
